buildGeographicScene.signature: buildGeographicScene({ candidate, extraction?, text?, now? }) -> GeographicScene
buildGeographicScene.input: Candidate uses lat, lon, name, source, numeric confidence, aoi_membership.aoi_ids. verified:true or validated:true is required; explicit false and ondemand-entity-extraction are rejected. No provider calls.
buildGeographicScene.output: Incident-compatible raw scene with geographic:true, anchor, string aoi, 4 keyframes and 4 typed steps. Unverified incident confidence and explicit geocoder provenance. Empty incident_ids, markers, evidence and timeline_events.
buildGeographicScene.identity: geo-scene-v1- prefix plus encoded canonical tuple [plan kind, safe provider source, resolved name, exact lat, exact lon]; no random IDs or truncated hashes.
buildGeographicScene.camera: Bearings 30/120/210/300; ellipsoid heights 2400/1200/900/1800 m; relative target distances 0/350/650/0 m within a 1200 m plan radius; time offsets 0/8/18/28 seconds.

createGeographicSceneStore.returns: load returns detached scene or null; list returns detached scenes or []; save/rename return {saved:true,id,scene} or {saved:false,reason}.
createGeographicSceneStore.safety: Versioned schema validation reconstructs allowlisted snapshots. Unknown root fields discarded. Corrupt stores never silently overwritten. Maximum 100 scenes / 1,000,000 serialized characters. Quota and security errors return failure, with read-after-write validation; no optimistic cache.

caveats: Coordinator must integrate conversion, director persistence and UI: current incidentSceneToProjectScene copies neither geographic nor anchor/provenance metadata, and existing director project validator does not accept new geographic fields.

Existing incident adapter derives the requested heights from zoom correctly, but uses its own 18-second timing. Honor explicit timeOffsetSec/28-second duration in geographic playback integration. Last step is an endpoint with durationSec:0, not a zero-duration flight.

Marina Walk and inlet/JBR are storyboard labels for relative camera targets, NOT separately verified landmark coordinates. Their waypoint metadata states landmarkVerified:false. No hardcoded Dubai coordinates, synthesized imagery, or incident assertions.
Pass now explicitly in production. Pure builder defaults to Unix epoch if omitted; time_utc denotes scene creation, not event occurrence.
Storage has no cross-tab compare-and-swap; simultaneous writes are last-writer-wins. Map-label preservation is declarative until coordinator playback consumes preserveMapLabels.
Only this agent's two source/test files and /tmp/gev-agent-07.json were written. No browser, deployment, full-suite run, or edits to project.js/incidentScenes.js/director APIs.
